title: Intro to GIS for archaeology
summary: Read coordinates, scale, coverage and provenance using the live research atlas.
body: The map displays longitude and latitude in WGS84. Analysis uses UTM zone 44N so distances and areas use metre units. A map point may represent an entire monument complex.
steps: Choose a site and note its OSM representative-point coordinates.
Inspect the selected analysis run and its grid resolution.
Compare the site-level model illustration with the much coarser terrain grid.
Turn both supported score factors off. Explain why an empty factor set must be unassessed rather than a low-potential prediction.
